_uitleg: Elk project is een blok tussen { }. Verplicht: id (uniek, kleine letters, geen spaties), title, image en tools. tools = de technieken/talen; dat is ook de categorie waarop je filtert. Een nieuwe taal (bv. "Python") krijgt vanzelf een filterknop en een skill-kaart. difficulty = "easy", "medium", "hard" of "extreme" (de projectenpagina sorteert van extreme naar easy). Optioneel: tagline, challenge (één zin over het probleem dat je oploste), description (lijst met alinea's), features, learned, featured (true = op de homepage), links {"live": "...", "code": "..."} (vul in, dan verschijnen er knoppen; zet code op "school" als school de code privé heeft gezet, dan staat er een melding in plaats van een link) en gallery (lijst met extra afbeeldingen). Afbeeldingen zet je in assets/img/projects/.

projects.title: Mythology Quiz
projects.tagline: Interactive quiz with lifelines and a score
projects.challenge: The whole quiz (questions, score and lifelines) runs without reloading the page. All game state is kept in JavaScript.
description: A quiz page about Slavic mythology. The player gets a question with four answer options each time and immediately sees whether the answer was right or wrong.

To make it more exciting, the quiz has a 50/50 lifeline that removes two wrong answers. The questions, the score and the lifelines are all managed with JavaScript, so the page itself never has to reload.
features: Questions and answers loaded into the page dynamically
50/50 lifeline with a limited number of uses
Score keeping and instant feedback on every answer
Glowing buttons and a gradient background in CSS
projects.learned: How to use JavaScript events, the DOM and a simple game state to build a complete user flow: from question to answer to score.

projects.title: GoldenGrin Slot Machine
projects.tagline: Browser game with bets, balance and spins
projects.challenge: Random reels, bets and balance have to add up after every spin. I split the win check into small, reusable functions.
description: GoldenGrin is a slot machine that runs entirely in the browser. You start with a balance, choose how much to bet and spin the three reels.
After every spin the game checks whether the symbols form a winning combination and updates the balance. There is also a separate page with the rules.
features: Three reels with random symbols
Betting system with balance and 'add money'
Win check after every spin
Separate page with the rules
projects.learned: Working with randomness, timing and game states, and splitting my code into small reusable functions.

projects.title: Mon-IN
projects.tagline: Social platform with accounts and posts
projects.challenge: From static pages to a real platform: users register, log in with sessions and posts are saved to and loaded from a database.
description: Mon-IN is a small social platform in the style of a professional network. Users can register, log in and publish posts that appear in a timeline.
Every post shows the name, job title, date and number of likes. All data is stored in a database and processed server-side with PHP.
features: Register and log in with sessions
Timeline with posts, profile pictures and dates
Like system per post
Responsive layout with Bootstrap
projects.learned: The step from static pages to a dynamic website: handling forms, managing users and saving and loading data from a database.

projects.title: Collectables
projects.challenge: Every user may only see their own collections, and the page also has to work neatly when there is no data yet.
description: A web application where logged-in users can create and view their own collections. Think of cards, figures or other collectibles.
The items are loaded from the database and shown as clear cards. Every user only sees their own collections.
features: Login with a personal greeting
Create new collections
Items from the database shown as cards
Empty-state message when there is nothing yet
projects.learned: Loading, structuring and presenting data, and thinking about what a user sees when there is no data yet.

projects.title: Unity Platformer
projects.challenge: Getting a playable feel with physics, colliders and input, all driven by C# scripts.
description: My first game prototype in Unity: a simple 2D platformer where the player can walk and jump between platforms.
The focus was not on graphics but on the basics: physics, input and the behaviour of objects through C# scripts.
features: Player movement and jumping with physics
Platforms with colliders
C# scripts for input and behaviour
projects.learned: How Unity works with GameObjects, components and C# scripts, and how to test an idea quickly with a prototype.

projects.title: Budget Buddy
projects.tagline: Manage your money after logging in
projects.challenge: It was my first time using Symfony, so connecting the project to a database was the hardest part.
description: Budget Buddy is a personal budgeting web app and my first project built with Symfony. Users create a free account, log in and keep track of their income and expenses.
The dashboard shows this month's balance, a bar chart of the last months and the most recent transactions, so you can see right away where your money goes and work towards your savings goals.
features: Register and log in with your own account
Add income and expenses as transactions
Monthly balance overview with a bar chart
Insights page that shows where your money goes
projects.learned: How a Symfony project is structured, and how to link it to a database so data is saved per user.
